verdict.rationale: There is no documented account-level export or offboarding feature. Data can still be pulled out piecemeal: files can be read and listed from sandboxes via the SDK, MCP server or REST API, and sandbox images are built from standard Dockerfiles, which are portable outside Blaxel. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (sandboxes, volumes, Agent Drive, job and agent configs, logs), stated open export formats, explicit offboarding/data-portability guidance, and independent corroboration.
